# Port Review Checklist: Port iv from Qt to Dear ImGui

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the port are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation starts. Covers feature parity and intentional differences, the seam and code-size constraints, and build/dependency/platform requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/](../contracts/), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: the author, reviewing before `/speckit-implement`.

## Parity: Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is every menu item, shortcut and mouse gesture of the current iv traceable to one of FR-010 to FR-022, with none left to "as today"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010 to FR-022]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the mouse button and modifier combinations (Alt-drag, middle and right button behavior) written down, or only referenced as "behave as today"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the reference for "as today" / "matches the Qt build" pinned to a specific build or commit, so parity has a fixed baseline? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Does FR-017 say whether the mouse-mode selector must be visible, given that it is created but hidden in the current iv? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 Does FR-011 identify which existing action steps MIP levels, or is "prev/next subimage and MIP level" one combined behavior that needs stating? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK006 Are keyboard-only menu access requirements (Alt mnemonics, arrow navigation) stated, or their loss recorded as an intentional difference? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the maximum length and ordering of the recent-files list specified in the spec, or only in data-model.md? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, data-model.md Settings file]

## Parity: Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Does FR-020 ("all persist across sessions") agree with data-model.md, whose settings table has no key for closeup average pixels? [Conflict, Spec §FR-020, data-model.md Settings file]
- [ ] CHK009 Do FR-023 (Print removed "from the ImGui backend") and research R12 / tasks T007 (removed from both builds) say the same thing? [Conflict, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK010 Do FR-029 ("may be removed outright") and tasks T008 (removes `FORCE_OPENGL_1` from both builds) agree on what is required versus optional? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the differences listed only in research R12 (busy cursor fallback, mnemonic underlines, plain-text dialogs) also listed among the intentional differences in the spec, as quickstart.md's "Done" rule requires? [Conflict, Spec §FR-023 to FR-029, Quickstart §Done]
- [ ] CHK012 Do FR-027 ("shares no state") and contracts/cli.md (OCIO options are passed to the new process) describe the same behavior, and is it stated whether `--rawcolor`, `--no-autopremult` and `--missing-pixels` carry over? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the default value of each preference stated once and consistently between spec, data-model.md and the current behavior (for example linear interpolation)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020]

## Parity: Measurability

- [ ] CHK014 Is "broadly familiar" / "barely noticeable change" turned into criteria a reviewer can apply, beyond the feature checklist? [Measurability, Spec §US2, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Can "a theme close to the current light and dark palettes" be judged objectively, or is an acceptance rule needed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "no worse than the Qt build" in SC-005 backed by a stated measurement method and tolerance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the idle-CPU expectation (plan.md, quickstart.md) present as a requirement in the spec? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]

## Seam and Code Size: Clarity

- [ ] CHK018 Is the line-counting rule defined once and identically in spec and quickstart.md: which files, whether CMake is included, what counts as "vendored", and that generated build-directory files are excluded? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §B6]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it clear whether the second half of SC-002 (no larger than baseline after Qt removal) is an acceptance criterion of this feature or of the later removal change, given research R14 says removal alone does not reach it? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002, Research §R14]
- [ ] CHK020 Does SC-004 ("diffs limited to backend seams") allow for the Qt-only preparation step, which edits shared logic (connect syntax, `Strutil::format`)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004, Plan §PR sequence]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the list of backend-specific areas in FR-007 consistent with the allowed `#if` sites in contracts/ivui-seam.md (for example GL capability checks and move-to-new-window appear only in the contract)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Contract ivui-seam]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "named action" in FR-008 defined well enough to implement later scripting: what the name is, and whether names must be unique (labels such as OCIO view names can repeat)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Research §R16]
- [ ] CHK023 Is "a localized change" in FR-009 given a concrete meaning (which files may change when panels move to separate OS windows)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, Research §R5]
- [ ] CHK024 Is US4's test "adding one menu action touches no more call sites than in the Qt build" stated with the current number, so it can be compared? [Measurability, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the seam contract state how its member lists were derived and how they are kept true (who updates it when shared code needs a new member)? [Completeness, Contract ivui-seam]
- [ ] CHK026 Is it documented which Qt versions (5, 6 or both) must keep building during the transition? [Gap, Assumption, Plan §PR sequence]

## Build, Dependencies, Platforms: Completeness

- [ ] CHK027 Does the spec state the minimum OpenGL context iv requires (compatibility profile, 2.1), which today appears only in plan.md and research R2? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for startup failure cases: no compatibility GL context available, GLFW cannot open a display, window creation fails? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK029 Is FR-004a ("X11 and Wayland chosen at runtime") consistent with allowing a system GLFW 3.3, where the platform is fixed at GLFW build time? [Conflict, Spec §FR-004a, Research §R4]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the Wayland-present, X11-headers-absent case covered, or is X11 an explicit hard requirement on Linux? [Coverage, Contract build-options]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the requirements for `OIIO_IV_EXTERNAL_IMGUI` complete: minimum version, required backends, and the outcome when the external package lacks them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract build-options]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the "at least one CI job auto-builds GLFW" expectation stated in the spec, or only in plan and tasks? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the condition for switching the default backend ("reaches parity") tied to named, checkable criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-030, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK034 Are license compatibility and the update policy for vendored code (who updates, when, security fixes) documented as requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Research §R5]

## Build, Dependencies, Platforms: Coverage

- [ ] CHK035 Are HiDPI requirements quantified (what "sharp" and "correctly sized" mean, per-monitor scale changes) so the checklist items can pass or fail objectively? [Measurability, Spec §FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Are settings-file requirements defined for two iv processes running at once (now more likely because Move to new window starts a second process)? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, FR-027]
- [ ] CHK037 Are settings-file requirements defined for an unwritable or missing config directory and an unset home directory? [Coverage, Edge Case, data-model.md Settings file]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the remote and minimal-desktop cases addressed for native file dialogs (SSH X forwarding, no dialog helper), beyond "a clear message"? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R6]
- [ ] CHK039 Are macOS application-identity expectations stated (dock name and icon, behavior of the background fork with a GLFW window), or recorded as out of scope? [Gap, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK040 Is SC-001's 60-second limit defined with its measurement method and machine class in the spec, matching quickstart.md check B5? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Quickstart §B5]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items tagged [Conflict] point at places where two documents currently appear to disagree: CHK008, CHK009, CHK011, CHK029
